lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Bread at the granary gate at noon. Lost: one red hen. The lower ford is closed by order of the Watch.
lines.direction: Quiet, clear storyteller; intimate and grounded. Let the cave's silence linger.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: BY ORDER OF CAPTAIN DAGNA HOLT. A great grey bear hunts the Southfield pens. A fisher's boy is missing. Bring proof of the beast's death to the Ford Watch.
lines.direction: Quiet, clear storyteller; intimate and grounded. Let the cave's silence linger.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Sixty gold, and a fitted Watch gift for each companion. Speak to the captain before entering the Cinder Hollow.
lines.direction: Quiet, clear storyteller; intimate and grounded. Let the cave's silence linger.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The pins have rusted into the old notices.
lines.direction: Quiet, clear storyteller; intimate and grounded. Let the cave's silence linger.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The passage narrows. Wet wings stir overhead; something thick moves beneath the dripping stone.
lines.direction: Quiet, clear storyteller; intimate and grounded. Let the cave's silence linger.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Pick marks cross the stone like a tally. Under an iron helmet lamp, a wiry foreman counts his frightened crew.
lines.direction: Quiet, clear storyteller; let the distant picks die away.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The last pick marks disappear beneath silk. Warm air carries the clicking of many feet.
lines.direction: Quiet, clear storyteller; intimate and grounded. Let the cave's silence linger.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A grey bulk rises from the ash. Its eyes hold the last light of a banked fire. There is hunger in them, and cold.
lines.direction: Quiet, clear storyteller; intimate and grounded. Let the cave's silence linger.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Ashmaw lowers its head. The ford's fallen ember sliver gutters in the wall, then crumbles to grey dust. Nothing remains to sell or carry. A heavy claw rests warm against the stone.
lines.direction: Quiet, clear storyteller; intimate and grounded. Let the cave's silence linger.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A small satchel, torn but empty. Inside, charcoal on folded paper: “Maud, I got out. I'll wait by your fire. Please tell Da.”
lines.direction: Quiet, clear storyteller; intimate and grounded. Let the cave's silence linger.
